interface.longDescription: Deep travel research workflow for museums and ancient architecture. Input a city name, auto-generates structured knowledge document (org-mode) + portable reference cards (PNG). Covers historical background, museum highlights, archaeological significance, and architectural heritage. Use when user says '旅行研究', '博物馆功课', '古建功课', 'travel research', '出发前功课', or provides a city name with intent to do deep cultural travel preparation.
